title: What to do about missing data

cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to discuss four different strategies for how to deal with missing data in your dataset.
cues.zh: 講師：這支影片討論四種處理資料集中遺漏資料的策略。

cues.en: Now, this video is presented in the context of regression, but some of these methods apply equally well to other kinds of analyses.
cues.zh: 雖然放在迴歸脈絡，有些方法也適用於其他分析。

cues.en: So these are kind of general strategies that are not necessarily specific to regression models.
cues.zh: 是一般策略，不一定限於迴歸模型。

cues.en: So here we have an example of a missing data point.
cues.zh: 這裡有個遺漏資料點的例子。

cues.en: So let's say we have two columns of data.
cues.zh: 假設有兩欄資料。

cues.en: So we measure two features of the universe.
cues.zh: 量測世界的兩個特徵。

cues.en: We'll call this, you know, we measure something at time point 1 and time point 2, and it looks like there are four, there's supposed to be four cells of data,
cues.zh: 例如在時間一與時間二量測，看起來有四個，應該有四個資料格，

cues.en: but this data point is missing.
cues.zh: 但這個資料點不見了。

cues.en: So where did that data point go?
cues.zh: 它去哪裡？

cues.en: Well, you know, there can be many reasons for missing data in a data set.
cues.zh: 資料集遺漏資料，有很多原因。

cues.en: There could be dropout, that means that you had a research participant who volunteered to be in the research but then didn't finish the experiment.
cues.zh: 可能有人退出，原本志願參與研究，卻沒有完成實驗。

cues.en: Or maybe sometimes in clinical samples if there's a patient group, they might die, unfortunately.
cues.zh: 臨床樣本的患者，也可能不幸過世。

cues.en: And then that leads to some missing data.
cues.zh: 因此造成資料遺漏。

cues.en: Maybe there were some noise or artifacts.
cues.zh: 可能有雜訊或假影。

cues.en: There was just some problems with the data and those data had to be removed.
cues.zh: 資料有問題，必須移除。

cues.en: And of course, there's also just simple mistakes.
cues.zh: 當然，也有簡單失誤。

cues.en: There's human error.
cues.zh: 人為錯誤。

cues.en: And so yeah, sometimes you just miss data, you lose data because of some honest mistakes.
cues.zh: 有時只是無心失誤，就漏了、弄丟資料。

cues.en: So several different reasons why you can have missing data.
cues.zh: 所以有許多原因。

cues.en: But the point of this lecture is to talk about what you can do about the missing data.
cues.zh: 但這堂重點是，該如何處理。

cues.en: So one option is a complete row wise removal.
cues.zh: 第一個選項，整列完全刪除。

cues.en: So we're removing the entire row of data, the data that we're missing, but we're also actually removing perfectly good data.
cues.zh: 刪掉整列資料，不只遺漏值，也會刪掉完全有效的資料。

cues.en: So when would you do something like this?
cues.zh: 何時這樣做？

cues.en: Well, if you're looking at paired data, so if these are paired samples data, let's say these are four different individuals, but each individual was measured at time one and time two.
cues.zh: 配對資料，例如四位不同個體，每個人在時間一與時間二都量測。

cues.en: So this data point is actually missing over here, so therefore we're missing a pair.
cues.zh: 這裡少了一點，因此缺少一個配對。

cues.en: So paired data, or if you're analyzing changes, so you wanna know how does this measure change over time from time one to time two.
cues.zh: 配對資料，或要分析時間一到時間二的變化，

cues.en: So then obviously that you just can't do that.
cues.zh: 顯然就無法計算。

cues.en: So you can just pull out this entire row, remove this entire row from the data, including the valid data point.
cues.zh: 可以把整列從資料移除，連有效資料點一起刪除。

cues.en: Now this would be a decent approach if you have a sufficient amount of data.
cues.zh: 資料充足時，是合理方式。

cues.en: If you don't have a lot of data, you might not want to remove good data unnecessarily.
cues.zh: 資料不多，就可能不想無謂刪除好資料。

cues.en: But if you have really a lot of data, and in general, it's better to err on the side of collecting more data than collecting not enough data.
cues.zh: 但如果很多，一般而言，收集得多總比不夠好。

cues.en: So if you have a sufficient amount of data, then it's probably fine to remove an entire set of data row wise like this.
cues.zh: 所以資料充足，整列刪除大概沒問題。

cues.en: Okay, so option two would be a selective removal, and that's where we leave this data point in and we only remove this data point.
cues.zh: 第二種，選擇性移除，保留這個資料點，只刪那個。

cues.en: So this can be the case for unpaired data, but it can also be the case for paired data, even if these come from the same individual, let's say this research participant moved to another country
cues.zh: 非配對資料可以如此，配對資料也可能。例如同一位參與者搬到另一國，

cues.en: and so was unable to participate in the time two measurement.
cues.zh: 無法參與時間二的量測。

cues.en: So then you might need to do a row wise removal like what I showed in the previous slide for some analyses, but there might be other analyses where you don't actually need to pair the data together.
cues.zh: 部分分析需要像上一張整列移除，但其他分析，可能不需要配對。

cues.en: So there could be some analyses where you can include this data value and exclude this data value.
cues.zh: 有些分析，就能納入這個資料值，排除那個。

cues.en: Okay, then we have option three, which is to replace this data.
cues.zh: 第三個選項，替代資料。

cues.en: And usually data replacement takes the form of the mean.
cues.zh: 通常以平均值替代。

cues.en: So you would compute the mean of the entire column and replace that missing value with the mean value of that column.
cues.zh: 計算整欄平均值，用該欄平均值替代遺漏值。

cues.en: Now, it's important that you take the mean over the column, the feature of the data and not the row, which would be the individual, because these could be, these different measurements
cues.zh: 要沿欄，也就是資料特徵求平均，不是沿代表個體的列，因為同一個人的不同量測，

cues.en: from the same individual could be on completely different scales.
cues.zh: 可能是完全不同尺度。

cues.en: So it's important to compute the mean of the relevant data.
cues.zh: 所以必須計算相關資料的平均。

cues.en: This is often used for smallish data sets when you really can't afford to lose any data.
cues.zh: 資料集較小、真的無法承受失去任何資料時，常用這種方式。

cues.en: Now the thing to keep in mind is this is not necessarily a really great approach, and that's because this individual might not be close to the mean.
cues.zh: 但不一定是很好的方法，因為這個人不一定接近平均值。

cues.en: So you might be adding some additional noise or unnecessary variability to the dataset by replacing with the mean.
cues.zh: 用平均值替代，可能加入額外雜訊或不必要變異。

cues.en: But it's an okay method and it's used sometimes, it's a bit of an old school method, I think.
cues.zh: 不過還算可以，有時會用，我覺得是有點老派的方法。

cues.en: A slightly better version of option three would be option four, which would be to predict what that data point could be.
cues.zh: 稍好的第四種，是預測那個資料點可能是多少。

cues.en: So here you would use some kind of predictive model.
cues.zh: 使用某種預測模型。

cues.en: You could use a regression model, for example, and you would use training and testing data like with the cross-validation idea
cues.zh: 例如迴歸模型，使用訓練與測試資料，就像之前介紹過的交叉驗證

cues.en: that I have introduced previously in the course.
cues.zh: 概念。

cues.en: So then the idea would be that you train the data, you train the model using all the features of the data that you have available for n minus one.
cues.zh: 用所有可取得的特徵，以 N 減 1 的資料訓練模型。

cues.en: So all of the subjects go into the training data except for the missing data points that you have.
cues.zh: 所有受試者都納入訓練，除了有遺漏資料點的那些。

cues.en: And then you treat these as your test data.
cues.zh: 再把那些當測試資料。

cues.en: So then you just generate a prediction for what this data value should be based on all the other features you have available.
cues.zh: 根據可取得的其他特徵，預測這個資料值應該是多少。

cues.en: So you can see that this is a slightly better way, it's just a more sophisticated data-driven way of replacement compared to option three where you're just replacing the mean.
cues.zh: 可以看到，比起第三種直接用平均值替代，這是稍好、更精緻、以資料為依據的替代方式。

cues.en: So this is useful if you have a sufficient amount of data and if you have enough other columns or data features to generate a useful predictive model.
cues.zh: 資料充足，而且有足夠其他欄、特徵，能產生有用的預測模型時，適合使用。

cues.en: So if you don't have a lot of features, then it could actually be that the regression isn't any better than just replacing with the mean.
cues.zh: 特徵不多，迴歸可能不比用平均值替代更好。

cues.en: So in this video, I presented a few different options for dealing with missing data.
cues.zh: 這支影片介紹了幾種遺漏資料的處理方式。

cues.en: You probably get the sense that none of these options is really great.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得，沒有哪種特別好。

cues.en: There actually isn't a really great way of dealing with missing data.
cues.zh: 確實沒有真正非常好的方法。

cues.en: Really the best thing to do with missing data is to avoid it in the first place.
cues.zh: 處理遺漏資料，最好一開始就避免。

cues.en: So to try to set up your experiment or your data collection so that you minimize the possibility of losing data.
cues.zh: 規劃實驗或資料收集時，盡量降低遺失資料的可能性。
